takeaways: GitHub Copilot for Azure can generate infrastructure-as-code scaffolding such as Bicep files from natural language, but the output still needs review for naming, security and standards.
The Azure Developer CLI (azd) turns environment creation, provisioning and deployment into one repeatable workflow that also simplifies onboarding.
Pairing Copilot with logs and telemetry from Application Insights or Azure Monitor speeds up hypothesis generation when debugging, as long as fixes are validated in staging.
hook: Too many Azure projects lose their first days to configs, authentication wiring and deployment scripts. This episode is for developers and teams who want to reach a working demo faster. You learn how GitHub Copilot for Azure, the Azure Developer CLI and AI-assisted diagnostics take you from prompt to deployed app.
